teleporter/32653.htm.text: Krun: There is a 'No Newbie' advisory in place. A strong evil power is felt inside Mithril Mines. Well, it's just an advisory. If you really want your tombstone to say 'We Told You So' go right on in.

links.text: Nothing scares me. I'm going in.

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32653-01.text: Krun: Ah, you must be Jinia Guild. A man came here earlier from the Guild - not sure what he was looking for. Whatever it was, it seemed urgent. From the look on your face, it sounds like you know who I'm talking about.

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32653-05.text: Krun: I'm sorry stranger, the blast has left the mines a mess and they cannot be entered at this time. Please come back later when it is secure.

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32653-04.text: Krun: Kegor already left. He wanted you to see their hideout when you got here. He also left this for you... I didn't open it, I just shook the box a little. Couldn't help myself!

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32653-02.text: Krun: He went into the deepest parts of the Mithril Mines, where a freezing poison currently affects all creatures who enter. I won't let you in without an antidote. If I did, you'd simply die along with him.

links.text: "I have an antidote. Please let me in."

Q10284_AcquisitionOfDivineSword/32653-03.text: Krun: You're sure? Let's see... Liar! You do not possess the antidote! Alright, since you have come all this way, I'll give you my last one. Are you ready? Let's just get this over with.

@questlist.text: Quest list window (the server lists the quests this NPC has for you; shown only when there is more than one).
